blocks.prompt: 7. Find the sum of 20 terms of the series whose \(r^{\text{th}}\) term is \(3r + 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa series ki terms likhi nahi, balke ek formula diya hai jo batata hai ke \(r\)th term kya hogi: \(3r + 1\). \(r\) ki jagah 1, 2, 3, ... rakhte jayein to terms milti jayengi.
Diya kya hai? General term \(a_r = 3r + 1\).
Find kya karna hai? Pehli 20 terms ka jama.
Plan: formula se pehli aur 20th term nikalna, tasdeeq karna ke A.P. hai, phir \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_r = 3r + 1\).
Humein find karna hai: \(S_{20}\).
Tareeqa: Jab general term \(r\) ka linear expression ho (jaise \(pr + q\), jis mein \(r\) ki power 1 ho), to series hamesha A.P. hoti hai aur us ka \(d\) wohi number \(p\) hota hai jo \(r\) ke saath hai. Is liye sirf pehli aur aakhri term chahiye.

Pehli chand terms likhein
\[a_1 = 3(1) + 1 = 4\]
\[a_2 = 3(2) + 1 = 7\]
\[a_3 = 3(3) + 1 = 10\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(r = 1, 2, 3\) rakha. Series 4, 7, 10, ... ban rahi hai, jo 3, 3 barh rahi hai.

Tasdeeq ke A.P. hai
\[a_{r+1} - a_r\]
\[= [3(r + 1) + 1] - [3r + 1]\]
\[= 3\]
Kyun: Sirf teen terms dekh kar A.P. kehna kaafi nahi; general term se agli term minus pichhli nikali to \(r\) cancel ho gaya aur hamesha 3 bacha. Matlab har jagah farq 3 hai, to \(d = 3\) pakka.

20th term nikalein
\[a_{20} = 3(20) + 1 = 61\]
Kyun: Formula ka faida yeh hai ke koi bhi term seedha mil jati hai; \(r = 20\) rakha aur 61 mila.

Jama nikalein
\[S_{20} = \dfrac{20}{2}(4 + 61)\]
\[= 10 \times 65 = 650\]
Kyun: Pehli aur aakhri term dono maloom hain, to \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\) sab se aasaan hai.
Dhyan dein: Kuch students \(3r + 1\) mein \(r = 20\) rakh kar 61 ko hi jawab samajh lete hain; 61 sirf 20th term hai, jama nahi.

Tasdeeq: doosra tareeqa
\[\sum_{r=1}^{20} (3r + 1)\]
\[= 3(1 + 2 + \dots + 20) + 20\]
\[= 3(210) + 20 = 650 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har term mein \(3r\) aur \(+1\) hai. \(3r\) wale hisse ka jama \(3 \times (1 + 2 + \dots + 20)\) hai, aur \(1 + 2 + \dots + 20 = \frac{20 \times 21}{2} = 210\). \(+1\) bees dafa juda, to \(+20\). Kul 650, wohi jawab.
